documented_gaps.statement: DGSFP RRPP LPS detail exposes no exact identifier (no LEI, no home NCA code, no home identification code). Only denominacion + pais de origen. No official crosswalk artifact (Anexo) was located for L-keys. Counting note: 825 Activa = 209 with LEI + 616 without; total without exact resolution is 617 (616 no-identifier + L1522, tracked separately under GAP-B2-L1522-STALE-LEI).
documented_gaps.consequence: No canonical edge can be produced for these keys without fuzzy matching, which is forbidden. They remain unjoined by design.

documented_gaps.statement: RRPP publishes LEI 7245004QN0BFE9Q9EV42 which GLEIF reports as INACTIVE; EIOPA lists the same undertaking under LEI 724500D3EHHJWKLWY913. Two official sources disagree; no silent merge performed.
